# RBAC permission matrix

<!-- GENERATED by `npm run docs:rbac` in services/pension-auth-service from src/domain/permissions.ts. Do not edit by hand: change the code, then regenerate. -->

Permission codes have the shape `pension:<section>.<resource>.<action>`. In code they are referenced ONLY as `P.<NAME>` (lib/permission-codes.ts, rule R-RBAC-1).

## 1. Roles

| Abbr | Role code | Name | Hindi | Scope | MFA | Permissions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SA | `super_admin` | Super Admin | सुपर एडमिन | STATE | yes | 51 |
| ADM | `state_admin` | State Admin (RSACS) | राज्य प्रशासक (RSACS) | STATE | yes | 33 |
| VER | `state_verifier` | State Verifier | राज्य सत्यापनकर्ता | STATE | yes | 19 |
| APP | `state_approver` | State Approver | राज्य स्वीकृतिकर्ता | STATE | yes | 24 |
| AUD | `auditor` | Auditor (read only) | लेखा परीक्षक (केवल पढ़ें) | STATE | yes | 15 |
| DIST | `district_officer` | District Officer (DAPCU) | जिला अधिकारी (DAPCU) | DISTRICT | yes | 12 |
| INCH | `center_incharge` | Center In-charge (Medical Officer) | केंद्र प्रभारी (चिकित्सा अधिकारी) | CENTER | no | 13 |
| WRK | `center_worker` | Center Worker | केंद्र कार्यकर्ता | CENTER | no | 14 |

Scope: STATE sees every District and Center; DISTRICT only its district; CENTER only its Center (lib/scope.ts).

## 2. Permissions by section

Legend: ✓ = the role template holds it. `scopes` = role levels allowed to hold it at all. 🔒 = sensitive (unmasked data or full export). ⛔ = non-delegable (only a Super Admin can grant a role holding it).
